summary: Perpetuals.com Ltd filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing the extension of its BayesShield AI technology into healthcare, specifically to improve diagnostic accuracy in hospitals. The filing describes the technology's methodology and partnership with the European Institute of Management but does not involve any acquisition, divestiture, or other special situation. It is a routine business update regarding a product expansion, with no deal terms, board recommendations, or structural changes. Thus, it classifies as a None special situation.
